mapper.select: SELECT ids.user_id, (COALESCE(chapter.chapter_points, 0) + COALESCE(quiz.challenge_points, 0)) AS learning_points FROM ( SELECT enrollment.user_id FROM learning_course_enrollment enrollment WHERE enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION SELECT mastery.student_user_id FROM assessment_ai_knowledge_mastery mastery WHERE mastery.total_score > 0 ) ids LEFT JOIN ( SELECT enrollment.user_id, SUM(progress.progress_percent) AS chapter_points FROM learning_course_enrollment enrollment INNER JOIN learning_chapter_progress progress ON progress.enrollment_id = enrollment.id WHERE enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY enrollment.user_id ) chapter ON chapter.user_id = ids.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mastery.student_user_id, SUM((100 * mastery.total_score DIV mastery.total_max_score) + CASE WHEN mastery.latest_score_percent >= 90 THEN 15 WHEN mastery.latest_score_percent >= 60 THEN 10 WHEN mastery.latest_score_percent > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) AS challenge_points FROM assessment_ai_knowledge_mastery mastery GROUP BY mastery.student_user_id ) quiz ON quiz.student_user_id = ids.user_id WHERE (COALESCE(chapter.chapter_points, 0) + COALESCE(quiz.challenge_points, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY learning_points DESC, ids.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
